summary: Completed backend pytest + multi-context UI integration testing for live product/announcement sync, admin product/resource controls, category grid/list behavior, and customer account regression on preview URL. Core requested flows pass with <=2s visibility checks. One backend auth preflight/CORS issue remains.

critical.issue: Preflight still returns 400 and omits access-control-allow-origin for preview origin; access-control-allow-credentials=true is present.

issues: List-view CSS targets .prod-image/.prod-info/.add-cart selectors, but JSX uses .product-media/.product-info/.add-cart-btn; list view still toggles, but fine-grained intended layout styling is partially mismatched.

action_items: Fix auth CORS preflight behavior for /api/auth/login: include OPTIONS handling and explicit access-control-allow-origin reflection for credentialed requests from preview origin.
Align category list-view CSS selectors with actual ProductCard class names (.product-media/.product-info/.add-cart-btn) for predictable list layout styling.
Optionally add a low-cost cleanup workflow for inactive TEST_* products/announcements to avoid admin catalog clutter during repeated QA runs.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is very large and mixes auth/catalog/admin/resource concerns; split modules to reduce regression risk and speed root-cause isolation.
CORS preflight behavior remains inconsistent with credentialed browser expectations despite same-origin paths working in normal flows.
Live sync architecture (1s polling + cache-busting + mobilecart:live-update/localStorage signal) is functioning end-to-end in browser tests for product + announcement updates.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested functional flows passed; one initial script-only assertion bug was corrected in targeted retest)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST live products and TEST announcements via admin APIs/UI; cleanup attempted. Note: product delete endpoint unpublishes (active=false) rather than hard-delete, so inactive test records may remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated no-manual-reload <=2s visibility for new active product + auto announcement (API + home strip) using separate admin/storefront browser contexts. Verified edit propagation <=2.2s in targeted retest. Category grid/list toggle works on desktop/mobile and toggle buttons do not overlap on 390x844. Customer account page loads wallet/history/orders/address sections without runtime errors. Console showed expected 401s for unauthenticated initial /auth/me probes only; no blocking runtime UI errors detected.
rca of the issue: Auth preflight failure reproduces with OPTIONS /api/auth/login (Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com, Access-Control-Request-Method=POST, Access-Control-Request-Headers=content-type). Response is 400 with allow-credentials=true but missing allow-origin; allow-methods also excludes OPTIONS. Mitigation: include OPTIONS (or '*') in app CORS methods and verify ingress/CDN preserves reflected origin for credentialed preflight responses.
